name: Staining Temples
text: Some priests have begun asking for temples to have stained glass, while some oppose it, what will you do?

choices.text: The light shall be revealled for any cost!
uniques: Comment [The light shall be revealed, for your priests celebrate your decision!]
Gain a free [Stained Copper Temple] [in this city] <if [Copper Temple] is constructed>
Gain a free [Stained Silver Temple] [in this city] <if [Silver Temple] is constructed>
Gain a free [Stained Gold Temple] [in this city] <if [Gold Temple] is constructed>
Comment [There was no need for stained glass, they are too expensive for this realm.]
